item.title: FCC bans new routers made outside the US, citing Chinese cyberattacks
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission issued a National Security Determination banning the sale of new foreign-made routers in the United States. The justification: cyberattacks such as Salt Typhoon, Volt Typhoon, and Flax Typhoon compromised American telecom networks via vulnerabilities in network hardware. — Read the rest The post FCC bans new routers made outside the US, citing Chinese cyberattacks appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: Undergrad makes nail polish that works on touchscreens
item.description: I've often marvelled at how anyone can get anything done with long fingernails, be they glued on at a salon or homegrown. When I've asked, the only answer I've gotten is "with practice." But thanks to an undergraduate at Centenary College of Louisiana, using a smartphone with elegant fingertips could soon become a hell of a lot easier. — Read the rest The post Undergrad makes nail polish that works on touchscreens appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: Rekindle adds apps and games to your Kindle browser
item.description: Rekindle is just a web page optimised for the somewhat terrible built-in Kindle browser, but it packs a ton of useful and fun content. It has utilities like notes, flashcards, and a Pomodoro timer, and access to non-Kindle books from Project Gutenberg and Libby. — Read the rest The post Rekindle adds apps and games to your Kindle browser appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: Jury: Meta must pay $375m for enabling child exploitation
item.description: Jurors in New Mexico found that Meta enabled child exploitation on its platforms, and assessed a $375m penalty for the violation of state consumer protection law this represents. item.title: Dem flips Mar-a-Lago Florida district
item.description: In 2024's election, the Florida legislature's 87th district went for Donald Trump by 19 points. It is, after all, the home of his Mar-a-Lago compound.
